create_cuda_communicator: create a CudaCommunicator instance from a cpu ProcessGroup for distributed GPU communication
build_all_reduce: build an all-reduce operation on a tensor with optional ReduceOp and fallback to torch.distributed
test_send_tensor: test sending a tensor to a destination rank via the CudaCommunicator send method
run_recv_tensor: run receiving a tensor of given size and dtype from a source rank via the CudaCommunicator recv method
review_destroy_communicator: review the CudaCommunicator destroy method that cleans up the underlying PyNcclCommunicator
